title: Manifold Welcomes Blake Moody as Onboarding Experience Specialist
body_markdown:
### Onboarded in 21 Days. No Annual Contract. No Excuses.


We have always believed the best way to earn a customer’s trust is to make it easy to leave. That is why Manifold runs month-to-month: no annual contracts, no lock-in, no leverage. Just technology that has to keep proving itself every single month.


And now we have made one more promise: every new customer is onboarded and fully trained within 21 days. In practice, that means you are in the product getting real value before your first monthly payment ever hits.


That promise has a name now. His name is Blake Moody.


### Time Kills All Deals. It Kills Implementations Too.


Anyone in freight knows the phrase: time kills all deals. The same is true for software implementations. A customer who signs and then waits weeks to go live is a customer who starts to wonder what they signed up for. Momentum fades. Questions pile up. The internal champion who sold it to their team loses credibility.


We built our 21-day onboarding guarantee specifically to stop that from happening. The clock starts the day the agreement is signed. Within three weeks, your team is trained, your workflows are configured, and you are operating in the platform. Nearly two weeks before your first bill.


That is not a marketing number. It is a commitment; and Blake Moody is the person who owns it.


### He Asked for the Blank Page


Blake joined Manifold as our Onboarding Experience Specialist, and he did not inherit a finished system. He built one. When we told him he was responsible for designing the onboarding process from scratch, he did not hesitate.


*“I joined Manifold because I was handed something rare: a blank page and the trust to make onboarding something customers actually remember. Getting to build that with a small team that cares this much was an easy yes.”*


The 21-day framework Blake has built is not a checklist. It is a structured experience: clear milestones, proactive communication, and someone who already knows what questions you are about to ask before you ask them. The goal is not just to get you live; it is to get you confident.


### Month-to-Month Means We Have to Keep Earning It


The 21-day guarantee and the month-to-month model are connected by the same philosophy: Manifold should only stay on your tech stack if it is the best technology experience you have ever had. That is not a tagline; it is the standard we hold ourselves to.


No annual contract means we cannot coast. Every renewal is earned. Every onboarding sets the tone for whether a customer stays, expands, and refers others. Blake owns that first impression, and he takes it seriously.


Welcome to the team, Blake. Twenty-one days. Let’s make every one of them count.


Ready to see what a 21-day onboarding actually looks like?[Schedule a demo](https://www.getmanifold.ai/contact) and we’ll show you.
